methodology.capture: All Top 100 form-score rows are archived at each discovery checkpoint, including rows without an available price.
methodology.odds_source: Persisted FanDuel, DraftKings, and BetMGM prices from MLB HR Edge only; this workflow never calls SportsGameOdds directly.
methodology.analysis_unit: Best archived price per player per slate. Multiple intraday captures remain in the raw archive but count once in ROI reports.
methodology.staking: One flat unit per priced player-game. Wins earn the archived American-odds profit; losses lose one unit; no appearances are void.
methodology.warning: Results are exploratory and sample sizes must be considered before treating any segment as a repeatable edge.
